name: Sales Lead Qualifier V2
description: Reads inbound sales enquiries from a shared mailbox, qualifies them Hot/Warm/Cold using BANT, and logs qualified leads to the native Dataverse Lead table with an email alert for Hot leads.
author: Pulkit Bhagat

details.markdown:
Configuration:
LeadTableName = the logical/schema name of the Dataverse table the Lead Agent creates records in, not the display name, which is present in solution.
NotifyEmail = the email address that receives the Hot lead notification.

Classifier Agent: reads the incoming email and classifies it against BANT (Budget, Authority, Need, Timing) into a Tier (Hot, Warm, Cold, or Filtered), extracting Company, ContactName, ContactEmail, Phone, Need, and an EmailSubject. Outputs a structured text block that the Lead Agent consumes next.

details.markdown: Lead Agent (owns Dataverse and Outlook tools): if Tier is Filtered, does nothing, no record, no notification. Otherwise it creates one Lead record in Dataverse (subject, firstname, lastname, emailaddress1, companyname, telephone1, leadsourcecode, leadqualitycode, description, budgetamount, purchasetimeframe) and emails NotifyEmail only for Hot leads.
Trigger: fires when a new email arrives in the shared mailbox. No subject filter — every incoming email is passed to the Classifier Agent to decide if it's a genuine sales enquiry.

If the Folder field shows "Loading..." after importing this solution, the folder ID is tied to the original mailbox. reopen the trigger and re-select the folder for your own mailbox connection before publishing or use clear to point to default Inbox.
